name: opencode-project-router
description: On-demand project discovery and destination-bound conversational routing
about: Finds the project you meant and keeps work pointed at it. It ranks the projects it knows against your own words, offers the top few when nothing stands out, records a project under an alias, clones an authorized repository without running its scripts, and binds a Quest to the directory you chose.
needs: the quests plugin for project_goal and project_verify
